Anand Mahindra Reacts to SUV Parked on Bihar House Roof

A video of a Scorpio SUV being lifted by a crane onto the rooftop of a two-story house in Gopalganj, Bihar, has gone viral. Anand Mahindra, chairman of the Mahindra Group, reacted to the footage, initially expressing surprise and calling it 'next level'. He later cautioned against attempting such actions, stating, 'Love is good, but here there is danger.' The incident has garnered significant attention online.
